authenticationFlows.description: The address is either free (a new account) or taken (linked). No profile form here: idp-review-profile lets a person edit the email before the check, which with auto-link is a takeover. VERIFY_PROFILE collects missing fields after the account exists.

Create the account when the address is free. Create User If Unique is also the duplicate check: on a duplicate it declines and the next alternative links. Do not put idp-detect-existing-broker-user first - it fails the flow instead of declining.

Existing account only: confirm, then link. No email check: trustEmail is on, so the provider proved the mailbox. The API's UnprovenPasswordGuard removes the existing password. Turning trustEmail off needs idp-email-verification back here.
